image_description: A low-angle shot of a weathered street sign assembly against a clear blue sky. The signs are mounted on a thick, textured concrete or wooden pole. There are two main rectangular signs intersecting at an angle; one is dark red/brown and the other is a similar dark tone. Both feature white text that appears distorted and illegible, resembling gibberish or alien script rather than standard language. A smaller green sticker or plate is affixed to the upper sign with similarly garbled white text. The pole shows signs of wear and rust.
